questions.stem_text:
Occasionally a boy is born withundescendedtestes (cryptorchidism), and he will be sterile
unless they are surgically caused to descend into the scrotum. Explain the reason for
this.

options.A: Human sperm cannot develop at the high temperature found within the body cavity.
options.B: The testes require the lower pressure environment of the scrotum for sperm maturation
options.C: Testes must be in the scrotum to properly attach to the vas deferens
options.D: The scrotum provides the necessary nutrients for sperm development
options.E: Gravity is required for the testes to function properly

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - Human sperm cannot develop at the high temperature found within the body cavity.

questions.stem_text:
Sea divers are aware of a danger known as the "bends". Explain the physiological mechanism
of the bends.

options.A: Carbon dioxide bubbles forming in the blood causing acidosis
options.B: Rapid increase in barometric pressure causing the bends
options.C: Formation of helium bubbles in the bloodstream due to rapid ascent
options.D: Increased salinity in the water leading to dehydration and joint pain
options.E: Oxygen bubbles forming in the blood leading to hypoxia

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - Carbon dioxide bubbles forming in the blood causing acidosis

questions.stem_text: What is the function of the contractile vacuole?

options.A: Protects the cell from foreign invaders
options.B: Acts as a storage for genetic material
options.C: Regulates the pH level within the cell

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - Protects the cell from foreign invaders

questions.stem_text:
Why is genetic drift less important in human evolution at present than it was twenty
thousand or more years ago?

options.A: The human genome has fully adapted to current environmental pressures
options.B: Modern medicine has eliminated the effects of genetic drift
options.C: The rate of genetic drift is directly proportional to technological advancements
options.D: Humans have reached a genetic equilibrium where drift is no longer possible
options.E: Humans have developed immunity to genetic drift

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - The human genome has fully adapted to current environmental pressures

questions.stem_text:
Chromosomal sex in mammals has been shown to be strongly Y chromosome determined. How was
this shown to be true?

options.A: The absence of a Y chromosome determines maleness in mammals
options.B: The presence of a Y chromosome usually determines maleness in mammals
options.C: The ratio of two X chromosomes to one Y chromosome determines maleness
options.D: The presence of an X chromosome determines maleness in mammals
options.E: The presence of an X chromosome in the absence of a Y chromosome determines maleness

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - The presence of a Y chromosome usually determines maleness in mammals
